description: Native time field with labels, constraints, picker access, and clearing.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Shows an embedded clear button while the field has a value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the field and its action buttons.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label associated with the native time input.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Latest selectable time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss format.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest selectable time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss format.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name submitted with the containing form; defaults to the initial inline content when omitted.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint forwarded to the native input; browsers may ignore it for date and time controls.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Clears the selected time and emits `input`, `change`, and `tp-clear`.

methods.name: showPicker(): void
methods.description: Opens the native time picker when supported by the browser.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the selected time is committed.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted when the selected time changes while editing.

events.name: tp-clear
events.description: Emitted after the embedded button clears the value.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-background
cssproperties.description: Background of the input control, excluding its label.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-border-color
cssproperties.description: Border color of the input control when it is not focused.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-focus-color
cssproperties.description: Border color and translucent outline tint while focus is inside the control.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-inline-size
cssproperties.description: Preferred width of the field, limited by the available container width.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-label-font-weight
cssproperties.description: Font weight of the field label.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-label-gap
cssproperties.description: Space between the label and the input control.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-padding-block
cssproperties.description: Inner spacing above and below the input value.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-padding-inline
cssproperties.description: Inner spacing before and after the input value; additional space is reserved for action buttons.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-radius
cssproperties.description: Corner radius of the input control.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-required-color
cssproperties.description: Color of the asterisk marking a required field.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timefield-value-font-weight
cssproperties.description: Font weight of the displayed input value.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-timefield>` element implements the <tp-icon name="timefield" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Time field functionality: native time field with labels, constraints, picker access, and clearing.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Type a time or use the browser's time controls. |
| Using the component | The display follows your locale. |
| Using the component | Use the clear control when available to remove the selected time. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Typing | <kbd>Enter</kbd> or edit the value using the field controls; read-only and disabled fields cannot be edited. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> on Clear | Activate the clear button when available. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
